keep: Clean crisp frames that show only this creature; the transparent background stays empty. Colors, brightness, material finish and lighting stay exactly as in the still in every frame. Existing colored markings remain steady and the same size. The creature keeps its original body proportions and full silhouette inside the canvas. Keep exactly four toad limbs, one head, two eyes and the single folded three-lobed mushroom cap. Its attached lantern nodules, gills and warts remain unchanged in shape, color and brightness.

clips.idle: Slow belly breathing with a tiny throat movement, four feet stay planted and the attached cap moves gently with the body.
clips.walk: Heavy toad walk in place on four limbs, stepping one foot at a time while keeping the mushroom cap attached.
clips.attack: Pulls its head back slightly, extends its head forward and closes its wide jaw once in the first half, then returns.
clips.hurt: Tucks its head and compresses its body briefly, then returns to its resting posture.
clips.death: Four limbs relax, belly sinks down and head rests forward, ending lying still with the entire mushroom cap intact.
